extracted.intended_audience: journalists, news organizations, donors, partners, and the public interested in ICFJ's work
extracted.subtask_description: ICFJ's organizational mission and guiding values for programs that strengthen journalism worldwide through training, mentorship, fellowships, research, and financial support, emphasizing independence, trust, inclusion, accountability, collaboration, and innovation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — enable a global network to provide trustworthy news
rubrics_metrics.description: We enable a global network of journalists to provide the trustworthy news essential to free and strong societies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Their vital work strengthens democratic ideals and spurs change. ICFJ serves more than 177,000 journalists around the world, helping them cover critical issues, innovate to connect with communities, and build news organizations that thrive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program mix — training, mentorship, fellowships, and financial support
rubrics_metrics.description: ICFJ programs include a mix of training, mentorship, fellowships and financial support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These program types are the mechanisms through which ICFJ equips reporters and editors, fosters innovation, and supports newsroom sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serve — equip reporters and editors
rubrics_metrics.description: We SERVE reporters and editors, giving them the tools and knowledge to cover the most critical issues of today.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus is on practical skills and knowledge that enable journalists to report on high-impact topics in their communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovate — adopt new tools and techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: We help journalists INNOVATE, using new tools and techniques to build trust and engage with communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes experimentation with technologies and storytelling methods that strengthen audience connection and trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thrive — support newsroom financial sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: We help independent newsrooms THRIVE financially, adopting effective business models to ensure they can serve their purpose well into the future.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs target business operations and audience reach improvements to promote long-term sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journalism as a pillar of democracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalism is a pillar of democracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By reporting in the public interest, journalists equip people with the information they need to participate in the democratic process; this principle underpins program choices and priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence is non-negotiable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All of the journalistic projects ICFJ supports maintain editorial independence. Operating free of outside influence is fundamental to journalism and a requirement for ICFJ-supported work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accountability matters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ICFJ supports reporting that holds the powerful to account and holds itself to account, operating at the highest standards for the profession.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion strengthens journalism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ICFJ strives to make its programming welcoming and supportive of all people and works to expand the diversity of voices shaping news coverage and those reflected in it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trustworthiness is foundational
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Without trust in news and its institutions, journalism cannot serve its highest purpose. ICFJ prioritizes trust-building in work with its network.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration and exchange
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ICFJ is committed to fostering a healthy exchange of ideas to surface and share solutions across borders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bold thinking and continuous learning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ICFJ encourages harnessing creativity to experiment, innovate, and embrace continuous learning in programs and supported journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact & reach — measurable global footprint
rubrics_metrics.description: The ICFJ network is 177,000+ journalists strong and over the last five years ICFJ has operated in 125 countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ICFJ leverages its global network to spread ideas; IJNet publishes opportunities, tips and trends in eight languages; cutting-edge research informs solutions and program design. These metrics and activities are used to communicate impact and justify program strategies.
